name: Multilayer network learning by back-propagation
description: A published procedure for adjusting multilayer neural-network weights so that internal units acquire task-relevant representations.

date.label: 9 October 1986
date.basis: Date or interval stated or closely scoped by the cited source; see event caveats.

events.statement: Rumelhart, Hinton and Williams published learning experiments using error back-propagation in multilayer neural networks.
events.scope: The 1986 paper and its demonstrated learning procedure
events.caveats: Earlier work on gradients and error propagation existed; this publication is not asserted to be the first derivation of back-propagation.
